lines: Media spend is paid directly to Google and Meta, in advance.
One-time fees (films, campaign build, production, models, locations, paid partnerships): 50% on signing, 50% on delivery.
Monthly fees: in advance, each month.
Programmes 01 and 02 continue month to month after the minimum term. 30 days' notice to end.
Footage and reels belong to Osha Jewels.
Landing pages are built and quoted separately.
